messages.subject: Saudi Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear SAMA Team,

Your Saudi recruitment and manpower platform serving major industrial and project-driven organisations makes this a relevant introduction. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, and I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where institutional relationships, responsible development and disciplined execution are central to performance.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
